dossiers.title: Experiments & Formalization
dossiers.entrance: Own experimental designs, candidate formal models, prototypes and test-oriented synthesis awaiting review.
dossiers.epistemic_boundary: Experimental/formal elegance is not evidence without appropriate observation or validation.

featured.kind: specialist celestial mechanics, CMB, QCD and spin reference expansion

passages.changes: An unresolved question becomes a testable candidate, prototype or formal experiment.
passages.guard: A candidate must name assumptions and what result would change confidence.

passages.changes: A candidate model enters explicit observables, falsifiers, calibration and uncertainty review.
passages.guard: Testing criteria must be stated before promotion claims.

next_work: Keep this Room knowledge-led unless a real structured dataset emerges.

dossiers.title: Research Programmes
dossiers.entrance: Own coordinated multi-Room research programmes, workstreams, source ledgers and promotion plans.
dossiers.epistemic_boundary: A Programme coordinates work but does not steal fact ownership from participating Rooms.

owned_bundles.title: World-system blueprints
owned_bundles.purpose: Reusable research templates for governance, law, finance, trade, infrastructure, technology, culture, labour, security and other observable systems.

owned_bundles.title: North Programme data
owned_bundles.purpose: Project programme evidence, geographic/system fields and relationship-oriented North research.

passages.changes: A research programme consumes world-system inputs and produces analyses or proposed outputs.
passages.guard: Programme coordination never steals identity/fact ownership from World Systems.
